name: sessionvoice
description: Ears and a mouth for a Claude Code agent: always-on listening (the room, or a phone call), a waiter that wakes the agent on the user's finished turn, and a mouth that speaks without blocking. Needs a speech server you run yourself: by default Parakeet on 127.0.0.1:8890 (VoiceMode's mlx-audio), or point it at any OpenAI-compatible STT; Apple speech (macOS 27) is opt-in via `ears install --apple`. Install the sessionvoice package for the `ears` and `mouth` commands; the heard ride-along hook is opt-in per seat (README, Install).
